verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys with Read/Write permission assignment per resource instead of full account access (airwallex-docs-4), and this extends to agent-specific credentialing via AgentOS MCP OAuth (role-gated, no money-out actions by default) and CLI OAuth restricted to Owner/Admin/Finance Admin roles (awx-supp-agentos-mcp, awx-supp-cli), with a live probe confirming the OAuth-gated MCP endpoint (airwallex-probe-5). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of granular scope configuration in practice, and no explicit documentation of per-agent short-lived or revocable token issuance beyond role/permission scoping.
